title: Ivo and the Oath
author: Orsen Ashgrove
blurb: Oscar Nakamura, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
